links.outcome: Agreement of AI TI-RADS classification with surgeon before and after software training and update
links.effect: Agreement rose from 128/176 (73%) in the first phase to 210/227 (92.6%) after update; re-evaluating the initial 110 patients, 194 vs. 176 nodules were correctly assessed.
links.quote: First phase: AI-supported TI-RADS classification corresponded to the assessor's in 128/176 (73%) of examined nodules; second phase: correspondence in 210/227 (92.6%).

unlisted_practices: Iterative retraining of AI on real-world data to improve diagnostic accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world performance and learning curve/update of an AI-supported 3D thyroid ultrasound software against an expert clinician, without testing a specific operational guardrail or organizational deployment practice.
